signals.name: totalAllocatedChars
signals.quantity: sum of String.length() of all HTML strings returned by html() during one execution
signals.storage: long[] array in System.getProperties() under key V1_COUNTERS; index 1
signals.reset: V1Guidance.getInput() zeroes counters[0] and counters[1] before each execution

signals.name: htmlCallCount
signals.quantity: number of html() invocations (cache misses) during one execution
signals.storage: long[] array in System.getProperties() under key V1_COUNTERS; index 0
signals.reset: V1Guidance.getInput() zeroes counters[0] and counters[1] before each execution

plans.retention: Primary: keep inputs where totalAllocatedChars exceeds current best. Secondary (flat signal): keep inputs that grow in length toward input_bytes=800000 to cross the threshold where the first html() call occurs. Tertiary: keep inputs that achieve a new maximum htmlCallCount.
mutation: byte-level: random byte flip, random byte insertion, random byte deletion, contiguous block overwrite (1-16 bytes)
repetition: duplicate a line-aligned region (between \n boundaries) and repeat it k times; also: double the entire input; grows toward input_bytes=800000 in < 16 doubling steps

dictionary: tokens from the attack path source code — \n (line separator), & (sanitizer special), < (sanitizer special), > (sanitizer special), " (sanitizer special), ' (sanitizer special), .error (message code suffix), . (article punctuation)
no encoder needed: input is plain UTF-8 text with no checksum or compression format
